The front end of the loaf has been sliced off, revealing a dense, textured interior composed of ground meat mixed with visible chunks of green vegetables (likely peppers or celery) and red flecks. The exterior crust is browned and appears slightly dry or crusted rather than heavily glazed. A white cloth napkin is visible in the upper left background, and a glass jar is partially visible in the upper right.
